cards.title: Obviously One of Us
cards.instruction: Act as though effortless acceptance of the bizarre premise proves you belong, and treat visible confusion as a personal risk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course I know the cloud salute. This hand means welcome.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It means release the rain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The previous clouds used it differently.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're getting soaked.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An enthusiastic response. Clearly they recognise me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can introduce me to your cloud family. I know the salute: this hand means welcome.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's rain. Shall I tell them you're new?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No need. The previous clouds used it differently. Your family will appreciate the traditional greeting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mother's raining directly on you. Come under my umbrella.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And refuse her welcome? Hold my phone; I'll greet your father with both hands.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 asserts prior knowledge; A3 invokes previous clouds and A5 treats the mistake as personal recognition.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's corrected salute causes A3's historical excuse; B4's soaking becomes A5's enthusiastic response.

relationship.evidence: B4 shares the wet consequence and challenges A's attempt to preserve insider status.

heightening.evidence: A5 treats worsening physical consequences as stronger evidence that A belongs.

specificity.evidence: A1's hand salute causes the rain identified in B2 and experienced in B4.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'Clearly they recognise me' completes the social defence without explanatory padding.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 claims knowledge of the cloud salute; A3 rejects being identified as new; A5 accepts getting soaked to preserve belonging.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's rain correction becomes A3's traditional-greeting defence; B4's umbrella offer becomes A5's refusal to reject Mother's welcome.

relationship.evidence: B2 offers an introduction that could excuse ignorance; B4 offers shelter. A's status anxiety transforms both helpful offers into risks.

heightening.evidence: After B4 reports direct rain, A5 refuses shelter and doubles the greeting with both hands, increasing bodily commitment to claimed fluency.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes meeting B's cloud family; B4's umbrella and A5's phone give actors clear practical choices despite loosely defined salute mechanics.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'And refuse her welcome?' directly reuses A3's greeting defence; handing over the phone makes the escalation concrete and economical.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 exposes the mistaken salute and offers to identify A as new; A3 claims older expertise to avoid that identification.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 offers shelter from Mother's rain; A5 treats shelter as rejecting the welcome and escalates the greeting to Father.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A consistently sacrifices correction and comfort to appear effortlessly familiar with B's impossible family customs.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 turns an offered rescue into a reason to demonstrate even greater belonging.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A protects insider status by presenting a mistaken response to the bizarre as established familiarity and personal recognition.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Generic face-saving could concern any mistake; this card makes acceptance of an impossible custom the test of belonging.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A3 claims experience with previous clouds, and A5 interprets rain as the clouds recognising A.

Separate internal reread: fidelity 5, A3 declines novice status and A5 treats shelter as rejecting a welcome; logic 5, B2's correction causes the historical excuse and B4's offered umbrella causes a stronger exposed greeting; relationship 4, B2/B4 offer tactful help A cannot comfortably accept; heightening 4, A5 commits both hands to the rain-producing salute; specificity 4, A1/B4 establish family and directed rain, though the cloud embodiment remains open; wit 4, A5's phone handover practically enables the doubled greeting. cards.title: Senior in the Strange
cards.instruction: Treat yourself as an experienced guide to impossible customs, offering patient instruction while preserving one unexplained advantage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Bow to the shadow first. Beginners waste their greeting on the person.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why the shadow?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It follows you longer. Basic courtesy.

beats.speaker: B

cards.title: The One Normal Thing
cards.instruction: Remain modest while controlling the single ordinary resource everyone needs to survive the increasingly impossible situation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm nobody important. I just have the only spoon that stays solid.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We need it for the floating soup.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. One bowl at a time, through me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't you lend it out?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd hate to become important through poor spoon management.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm just serving soup. This spoon's the last utensil that hasn't melted.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're starving, and the soup's floating out of reach. Let me use it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll catch it for everyone. Send the smallest children first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's rising towards the ceiling. I'll lift you if you feed my daughter next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. I'm only the server; you're the legs. Carry me from child to child, and I'll portion what we catch.

cards.title: Competing Theories
cards.instruction: Create several explanations for what is happening. Test each new clue against them, and switch allegiance whenever one theory gains strength.

cards.title: Customs Interpreter
cards.instruction: Act as the translator of unwritten customs. Correct breaches, explain exceptions, and make your usefulness proof that you belong.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't sit in that chair at the family dinner. That's where absent people go.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who's absent?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll find out when someone complains you're in their chair.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll stand, then.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Standing means you're leaving. Let me introduce you as undecided.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At your family's dinners, that chair stays empty for your aunt.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's abroad. Sit with us.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only her grandchildren can borrow it. I learned that at Easter.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then take mine. I'll fetch another.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yours faces the kitchen; whoever sits there explains the dishes. Yes, I know them all now.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a family dinner and disputed chair; A5 gives the standing guest a social interpretation.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's introduction as 'undecided' economically extends the chair problem created in A1.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 explains the grandchildren exception; A5 turns knowledge of kitchen-facing seating and dishes into proof of belonging.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's absent aunt prompts A3's restricted borrowing rule; B4's offered chair becomes A5's opportunity to perform a family role.

relationship.evidence: B2 warmly invites A to sit and B4 sacrifices their own chair; A5 accepts inclusion through usefulness rather than continuing a quarrel.

specificity.evidence: A1's aunt's chair, A3's Easter memory and A5's kitchen-facing seat establish a readily playable family dinner.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'I know them all now' economically reveals effort and longing, though the seating explanation carries noticeable exposition.

cards.title: The Necessary Signature
cards.instruction: Remain helpful while controlling the one approval, record, key, or ceremonial step that allows anything to move forward.

cards.title: The One Who Lets You Win

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 prices the repair as dinner, A3 recalculates after B2 recalls repayment, and A5 treats B4's refusal as another favor.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's repayment produces A3's surplus calculation; B4's refusal to be cooked for produces A5's saved-work debt.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants the account settled and B4 wants to avoid another meal, forcing A to change the basis of indebtedness.

heightening.evidence: A5 makes B4's attempt to stop repayment increase the debt, tightening the same self-perpetuating obligation.

brevityWit.evidence: B4's 'Please don't cook again' and A5's saved-work interpretation deliver a compact reversal fully earned by the favor accounting.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 says the repair repaid dinner; A3 argues the repair's quality overpaid the original favor.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 refuses further cooking; A5 counts the labor saved by that refusal as fresh kindness.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: Accepted help, remembered help and refused help each trigger a new balance calculation.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: The attempt to end repayment becomes another reason A owes B.

cards.title: The Debt Changes Hands
cards.instruction: Treat every favor as shifting who owes whom. Recalculate the balance whenever help is accepted, refused, or remembered.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I brought your parcel upstairs. We're even for the lift yesterday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It was addressed to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you've been storing it. I owe you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only noticed it just now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. You saved me from thanking you excessively. Another favour.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your parcel's upstairs. We're even for yesterday's lift.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's yours. I brought it in from the rain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I owe you twice. I'll take your rubbish down.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Three flights with a leaking bag? That clears both debts.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leaking? That puts you in debt. You can repay me by cleaning the stairs behind me.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 settles a lift debt and A3 assigns storage debt; A5 labels restrained thanking another favor without a concrete new balance.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 uses B2's address correction, but A5's saved excessive thanks is a strained consequence of B4 only just noticing.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 correct facts but have little practical stake beyond rejecting A's mistaken thanks.

heightening.evidence: A5 adds another favor after B4, but its consequence is less tangible than A3's storage obligation.

specificity.evidence: A1 supplies stairs, a parcel and yesterday's lift; B2's ownership correction is readily playable.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's excessive-thanks explanation feels constructed to extend the exchange after B4 rather than necessary accounting.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 declares the lift repaid, A3 restores and doubles A's debt after B2's correction, and A5 makes B the debtor when B4 reveals the leaking bag.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 establishes that the parcel rescue was another favor to A, motivating A3's two debts. B4's leak motivates A5's stair-cleaning repayment; valuation remains deliberately subjective.

relationship.evidence: B2 corrects ownership rather than merely agreeing. B4 actively negotiates settlement by valuing the three-flight rubbish trip against both debts.

heightening.evidence: B4 offers a complete settlement, but A5 converts the newly disclosed mess into a reversed debt and recruits B to follow behind cleaning.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes neighbors exchanging a lift and parcel help; B4's three flights and leaking bag make A5's proposed repayment immediately playable.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'owe you twice' compresses the recalculation, and A5's cleaning request turns the leak into a concrete extension of the debt accounting.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 corrects the parcel's ownership and identifies B's rain rescue, leaving A owing both the earlier lift and this additional favor.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 discloses that the bag leaks; A5 increases the favor's price and requests cleaning of the resulting trail as repayment.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A1, A3 and A5 repeatedly recalculate obligation as ownership, accepted help and the work's difficulty become clear.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 moves beyond declaring a balance to arranging a fresh reciprocal service, leaving B room to bargain further.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A recalculates a favor account after corrected parcel ownership and newly disclosed rubbish conditions, finally reversing who owes whom.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Ordinary bargaining over an unpleasant task would dispute its effort without carrying forward the lift and parcel as an explicit two-favor balance.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A3 counts B2's rain protection alongside A1's lift, B4 explicitly offers to clear both debts, and A5 prices the leaking bag above that settlement.

recommendedEdit: Corrected the rejected revision's unsupported dry shoes and incomplete accounting. Retained the neighbor, parcel, rain and rubbish setting; replaced wet cardboard with a leaking bag whose cleanup creates the final repayment. FirstPass remains the exact original assessment. Separate internal coach-1.0 reread: fidelity 5, because A1, A3 and A5 revise the creditor and balance; logic 5, because B2 establishes a second favor for A3 and B4 explicitly clears both before A5 adds the leak premium; relationship 4, because B4 accepts useful help and proposes a settlement A can dispute; heightening 4, because A5 turns B4's settlement into a fresh obligation for B; specificity 5, because A1's upstairs parcel and B4's three flights make the chore concrete; brevity 4, because A5's cleaning request follows directly from the leaking bag without a separate joke. Total 92. Five spoken ABABA turns, under 75 words, and all hard gates pass on internal reread.
remainingConcern: The parcel ownership mistake needs a credible delivery, and A's debt pricing is opportunistic rather than consistent. Neither breaks the exchange; no rewrite is needed.
writerReservation: A assigns the leak a self-serving value above two favors. The account is explicit, but its valuation and B's willingness to clean remain open to challenge.
alternativeComparison: The preserved alternative keeps A indebted by interpreting even refusal as kindness. This alternative reverses the creditor through bargaining over unpleasant practical work.

cards.title: We Keep Switching Places
cards.instruction: Return to a familiar relationship pattern, then reverse who performs each role whenever the scene reaches similar pressure.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You fix the leaking tap this time. I'll stand here saying it'll flood.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It might. I can't find the valve.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine, give me the spanner. You're better at worrying.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Actually, turning this stopped it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. I'll return to wondering whether it'll start again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The tap's leaking again. Give me the spanner before you start pricing lifeboats.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've found the valve. You look terrified.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you fix it. I'll keep the towels ready for when the kitchen goes under.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The valve's stuck. What if I snap it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Give me the spanner. You take the towels; you've reached the sinking-kitchen stage.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 swaps fixer and worrier after B2, but A5 swaps back after B4 resolves the leak rather than at renewed similar pressure.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's missing valve motivates A3's intervention and B4's success motivates A5's withdrawal, though pressure no longer matches.

relationship.evidence: B2 needs practical help and B4 finds a solution, but A1 mostly announces the relationship roles.

heightening.evidence: A5 resumes worrying after B4 stops the water, without a new consequence or comparably urgent problem.

specificity.evidence: A1's leaking tap, B2's valve and A3's spanner provide a clear domestic task.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'better at worrying' is concise and motivated, while A5 neatly echoes A1.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 assigns fixer and catastrophizer, A3 reverses those roles, and A5 reverses them again when B4 panics.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's valve discovery and observation of A's fear cause A3's handover; B4's fear of snapping it causes A5 to take charge.

relationship.evidence: B2 offers competence and B4 reveals its limit, making B an active participant in the familiar division of roles.

heightening.evidence: B4's stuck valve adds a concrete risk, and A5 reassigns both spanner and towels around that renewed pressure.

specificity.evidence: A1's recurring leaking tap, B2's valve and A3's towels establish an immediately playable domestic repair.

brevityWit.evidence: A1's lifeboats and A5's 'sinking-kitchen stage' give the repeated panic role a concise shared vocabulary.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 identifies the valve and A's fear; A3 transfers repair responsibility and adopts catastrophic towel readiness.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 becomes frightened of breaking the valve; A5 resumes fixing and assigns B the anxious supporting role.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A repeatedly redistributes the same two relationship roles as similar repair pressure returns.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: The second reversal occurs with a stuck valve and feared breakage, giving the familiar swap greater practical pressure.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A reinstates a familiar fixer-and-worrier relationship, then reverses the assignments when the same flooding anxiety resurfaces.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Ordinary delegation would distribute the plumbing work once rather than repeatedly exchange the practical and anxious roles.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Revised A1 assumes A fixes and B catastrophizes; A3 reverses those roles after B2, and A5 reverses them again after B4's fear.

recommendedEdit: Kept the leaking-tap setting and replaced resolution-driven swapping with recurring pressure. Separate internal coach-1.0 reread: fidelity 5, logic 5, relationship 4, heightening 4, specificity 5, brevity 4 = 92. A1 establishes familiarity, B2 triggers A3's retreat, and B4's stuck valve and anxiety cause A5 to reclaim fixing. All gates pass.
remainingConcern: A3 accepts B's diagnosis of terror abruptly, and A5 partly names the pattern aloud. Both remain playable. No rewrite needed.
writerReservation: The sinking-kitchen language is heightened domestic exaggeration; the actual leak's severity remains available for the scene to develop.
alternativeComparison: This version swaps practical tools and domestic roles twice; the projector version uses reassurance and a professional fallback plan.

cards.title: We Keep Switching Places
cards.instruction: Return to a familiar relationship pattern, then reverse who performs each role whenever the scene reaches similar pressure.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Today you reassure me about the presentation. I'm usually the calm one.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. It'll be brilliant. Unless the projector fails.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll check the projector. You breathe.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's working. See? Nothing to worry about.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then let me worry about the audience while you stay impressively calm.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The projector's dead. Usually I talk you down, but today I need you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can use my laptop. Nobody's going to die.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep saying that while I imagine twelve directors sharing one screen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My laptop's dead too. We're finished.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nobody's going to die. I'll print twelve copies; you sit down before we need thirteen.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 names the usual calm role and A3 reverses the current roles; A5's second reversal follows reassurance rather than renewed equipment pressure.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 uses B2's projector fear, but A5 introduces the audience after B4 says the projector works.

relationship.evidence: B2 tries to reassure and exposes anxiety; B4 recovers enough confidence to reassure A again.

heightening.evidence: A5 moves to audience worry after B4 but mostly requests the same reassurance as A1.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a presentation and B2 identifies the projector as a concrete source of worry.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'You breathe' quickly reverses the dynamic; A5 is concise but more descriptive than consequential.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 explicitly reverses the usual calming role, while A5 resumes it when B4 reaches the same equipment-failure panic.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 imagines B2's laptop solution serving twelve directors; A5 replaces B4's failed laptop with printed copies.

relationship.evidence: B2 reassures A and offers equipment, then B4 needs the reassurance B previously supplied.

heightening.evidence: B4 removes the backup device, requiring A5 to become both calmer and problem-solver under greater presentation pressure.

specificity.evidence: A1's dead projector, A3's twelve directors and A5's twelve copies clearly establish the meeting emergency.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's repeated 'Nobody's going to die' earns the reversal, but 'before we need thirteen' makes the extra-copy joke harder to parse.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 offers a laptop and reassurance; A3 asks for continued reassurance while exposing the laptop's audience-size problem.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 loses the backup and panics; A5 borrows B's reassurance and supplies a paper fallback.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A starts as the unusual recipient of reassurance and becomes the familiar reassuring fixer when B collapses.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 restores the usual roles only after both display options have failed.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A reverses a familiar reassuring role, then takes it back when a repeated equipment failure transfers panic to B.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Generic anxiety would leave A frightened throughout; the recurring technical pressure instead changes who comforts whom.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Revised A1 names A's usual reassuring role, A3 accepts B's reassurance, and A5 repeats B2's calming words back after B4 panics.

Separate internal coach-1.0 reread: fidelity 5, logic 5, relationship 4, heightening 4, specificity 5, brevity 4 = 92. B2's laptop causes A3's screen concern; B4's second failure makes A5 become the practical reassurer. All gates pass.

cards.title: Become What You Compete With
cards.instruction: Turn comparison into imitation: adopt whatever quality seems powerful, allowing each borrowed trait to change the basis of the rivalry.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your cake won because it was minimalist. I'm removing half my decorations.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yesterday you called mine bare.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before restraint became our competitive frontier.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're copying me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Improving. I've now removed the cake stand too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your cake won because it was minimalist. I'm removing half my decorations.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I won for giving everyone a slice. Yours stayed behind glass.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll serve pieces twice your size. Pass me the knife.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's a queue of twenty. I cut mine small so nobody missed out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then mine will be thinner. I'll feed the queue and the people they go home to.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 adopts the winning cake's minimalism, A3 makes restraint the competitive criterion, and A5 tries to exceed B on that criterion.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 reinterprets B2's reminder of criticism; A5 answers B4's copying accusation by claiming a further subtraction.

relationship.evidence: B2 remembers A's disparagement and B4 wants the imitation acknowledged.

heightening.evidence: B4's challenge prompts A5 to extend restraint beyond decorations to the cake stand itself.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a cake competition and visible decorations; A5 offers a playable additional removal.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's competitive frontier is inflated but purposeful, and A5's cake-stand subtraction follows that exact criterion.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 copies perceived minimalism, A3 copies sharing as larger portions, and A5 copies inclusive distribution as thinner portions; each borrowed quality changes the rivalry.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 replaces decoration with sharing as the winning quality, causing A3 to serve cake. B4 explains the twenty-person queue, causing A5 to reverse portion size.

relationship.evidence: B2 challenges A's glass-protected cake, and B4 wants everyone in the queue served. B has a practical concern beyond supplying competitive prompts.

heightening.evidence: B4's concern that nobody miss out prompts A5 to expand the imagined beneficiaries from twenty people to their households.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes rival cakes and removable decorations; B2's glass display, A3's knife and B4's queue provide concrete choices actors can play.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'twice your size' and A5's 'thinner' make the competitive reversal economical; the household promise follows A's escalating imitation.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 identifies sharing as the source of success; A3 abandons merely removing decorations and offers competitively generous slices.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 explains that small slices allowed twenty people to eat; A5 adopts thin slicing to compete on the number fed.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A repeatedly imitates B's newly identified strength while attempting to exceed it, changing the contest from appearance to generosity to reach.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 retains the same cake-sharing rivalry and expands its ambition to people beyond the actual queue.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A imitates each newly perceived source of B's success, moving the rivalry from visual restraint to generous portions and then to how many people can be included.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Single-axis one-upmanship would keep subtracting decorations; A instead reverses the portion strategy when B reveals that inclusion made small servings powerful.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A1 borrows minimalism, A3 borrows B2's sharing as larger portions, and A5 abandons that size contest for B4's small-slice inclusion.

recommendedEdit: Replaced the rejected original's continued subtraction with successive changes in the perceived winning quality. Kept the cake competition and added a serving queue and A's glass display as illustrative circumstances. FirstPass is preserved exactly. Separate internal coach-1.0 reread: fidelity 5, because A1, A3 and A5 imitate success on changing terms; logic 5, because B2's sharing causes A3's large portions and B4's queue and small slices cause A5's thinner portions; relationship 4, because B2 corrects A's explanation and B4 protects the waiting guests' access; heightening 4, because A5 extends B4's inclusion goal to guests' households; specificity 5, because A1 establishes the cakes and B4 supplies twenty waiting people; brevity 4, because A5's thinner slices visibly reverse A3's boast without explaining the card. Total 92. Five spoken ABABA turns, under 75 words, and all hard gates pass on internal reread.
remainingConcern: B is principally the correcting winner, and feeding whole households is a boast rather than a demonstrated consequence. No rewrite is needed.
writerReservation: A assumes ever-thinner slices will improve generosity; the finite cake may make that claim self-defeating. The scene leaves B and the queue free to expose that limit.
alternativeComparison: This alternative makes competitive imitation produce increasingly inclusive hospitality. The preserved supplier alternative concerns colleagues' speaking habits and investigative negotiation tactics.

cards.title: Become What You Compete With
cards.instruction: Turn comparison into imitation: adopt whatever quality seems powerful, allowing each borrowed trait to change the basis of the rivalry.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your calm negotiating style is very effective. I'll speak even more quietly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You normally shout over me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An outdated phase of my restrained development.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can't hear you now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I've achieved a level of composure you haven't reached.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You got the supplier's price down by staying calm. I'll be quieter on our next call.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You shouted through this one. I need you to let me finish.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll leave longer pauses than you. We'll see whose silence saves more.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I got the discount by asking about damaged boxes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll ask about every dent. You can handle the quiet part.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 copies calm negotiation through quieter speech and A5 claims superiority, but calm is reduced to volume throughout.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 responds to B2's remembered shouting; A5 directly revalues B4's inability to hear as superior composure.

relationship.evidence: B2 objects to past shouting and B4 cannot hear, but neither turn establishes what B needs from the negotiation.

heightening.evidence: B4 identifies practical failure and A5 converts it into winning the comparison.

specificity.evidence: A1 mentions negotiating style without identifying the transaction, roles or immediate task.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 earns its absurd claim from B4's hearing problem, while A3's restrained development is more ornamental.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 borrows B's apparent calm, A3 competes through longer pauses, and A5 adopts damage questioning after B4 identifies the effective tactic.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's request to finish becomes A3's competitive silence; B4's damaged-box explanation redirects A5 to every dent.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants room to negotiate, and B4 corrects A's understanding of the discount rather than merely objecting to imitation.

heightening.evidence: A5 claims exhaustive dent questioning and reallocates quietness to B, expanding A's competitive takeover of the next call.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes supplier pricing, B2 identifies disruptive shouting, and B4 gives the concrete source of the discount.

brevityWit.evidence: A3 turns silence into a contest, and A5's 'You can handle the quiet part' neatly discards the trait A first coveted.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 asks A to stop shouting over B; A3 adopts pauses but turns compliance into a contest over savings.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 credits damage questions, not silence; A5 switches to more extensive damage questions and gives silence back to B.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: Each perceived source of B's effectiveness changes what A imitates and tries to exceed.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 extends the newly borrowed tactic to every dent and reshapes their negotiating roles.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A repeatedly imitates whichever aspect of B's negotiation appears successful and shifts the rivalry to outperform B at that borrowed quality.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Ordinary learning from a colleague would adopt useful techniques without converting each correction into a new contest.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Revised A3 competes over whose silence saves more; after B4 identifies damaged boxes, A5 switches to outdoing B's detailed questioning.

recommendedEdit: Made the negotiation concrete through a shared supplier call and discount. Separate internal coach-1.0 reread: fidelity 5, logic 5, relationship 4, heightening 4, specificity 5, brevity 4 = 92. B2's need to finish informs A3's pauses; B4's explanation redirects A5's competitive imitation. All hard gates pass.
remainingConcern: The supplier's actual response remains prospective, but A's committed next-call tactics are clear. No rewrite needed.
writerReservation: A5 assumes more detailed questioning will outperform B's useful question; that mistaken competitive inference is the intended behavior.
alternativeComparison: This changes the competitive measure in response to new information; the cake alternative only increases the amount of an existing trait.

cards.title: The Incident Keeps Changing
cards.instruction: Carry an unnamed past rupture whose meaning shifts with each new detail, while never letting its emotional weight diminish.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I still haven't forgiven you for missing my concert.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was outside. They wouldn't let me in.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you were close enough to hear and still didn't call?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I heard you dedicate a song to me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So you knew exactly how abandoned I felt, in perfect acoustics.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can give you another concert ticket. That doesn't mean we're past that evening.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was outside the door the whole time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So it wasn't distance. You were that close and left me alone with it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I heard you say my name. I thought you wanted me to stay out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then what I carried as silence was you listening. I don't know how to hand you this ticket now.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 explicitly names missing the concert as the rupture, contradicting the unnamed requirement despite A3 and A5 preserving its weight.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 uses B2's proximity and A5 uses B4's heard dedication, though perfect acoustics overstates what B established.

relationship.evidence: B2 offers exclusion as an exculpatory detail and B4 reveals having heard a personally meaningful dedication.

heightening.evidence: B4's evidence of attention becomes A5's stronger charge that B understood the abandonment.

specificity.evidence: A1's concert, B2's barred entrance and B4's dedication create a coherent shared event.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's acoustics phrase draws on B4's hearing, but adds polish at the expense of emotional plainness.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 leaves the rupture unnamed; A3 changes absence into nearby abandonment, and A5 changes silence into listening without easing the hurt.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's position outside the door drives A3's proximity accusation; B4's hearing A's name drives A5's reinterpretation of silence.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 disclose proximity and a misunderstood cue, giving B a perspective beyond simple denial.

heightening.evidence: A5 makes the new understanding interfere with the ticket A1 was prepared to offer, increasing the present consequence.

specificity.evidence: A1's concert ticket and B2's door ground the unnamed incident, though the reason B4 heard exclusion remains deliberately uncertain.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'that close' and A5's difficulty handing over the ticket concentrate emotional change without unrelated comic decoration.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 reveals physical closeness; A3 revises the wound from distance to abandonment despite proximity.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 reveals active listening and a mistaken interpretation; A5 revises the meaning of B's silence and hesitates over the ticket.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: Each detail changes the interpretation of one unnamed rupture while preserving its emotional weight.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 carries the revised past into the current decision to include B again.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A maintains the full emotional burden of an unnamed rupture while each new detail changes whether it means absence, chosen distance or listening without joining.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: A fixed grievance would use every detail to repeat one accusation; A changes the understood nature of the injury without resolving it.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Revised A1 leaves 'that evening' unnamed, A3 reinterprets B2's proximity, and A5 changes silence into listening because of B4.

recommendedEdit: Removed the named rupture while retaining a concert context and adding a present ticket offer. Separate internal coach-1.0 reread: fidelity 5, logic 5, relationship 4, heightening 4, specificity 4, brevity 4 = 90. cards.title: The Incident Keeps Changing
cards.instruction: Carry an unnamed past rupture whose meaning shifts with each new detail, while never letting its emotional weight diminish.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I thought your apology was for forgetting my birthday.

beats.text: It was for sending your present to the wrong address.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You remembered, but somebody else got it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your old flat. I was trying to surprise you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Now I have to forgive both disappointment and an extremely informed stranger.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Help me answer this letter. I still can't read your handwriting without going back to that afternoon.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wrote it before you arrived.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it wasn't something I said. You'd already decided.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

cards.title: Every Compliment Raises the Bar
cards.instruction: Treat each compliment as sincere admiration and a new standard you must immediately surpass.

beats.speaker: B

cards.title: Relief Is Suspicious
cards.instruction: Treat every reassuring development as evidence that the real threat has merely changed shape.

beats.text: They checked everything twice.

beats.text: Whatever escaped that deserves a more serious inspection.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So the trouble's moved into the tanker. Is it still outside?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's sealed. Nothing can escape.

beats.speaker: A

hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 offers a sealed container as reassurance; A5 interprets that seal as dangerous pressure and requires its removal.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A3 and A5 repeatedly reinterpret successful mitigation as transformed danger.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 escalates A3's suspicion into a condition affecting opening and diners.

beats.text: Fine, the fountain grants wishes. Who pays its water bill?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It can wish the water free.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then who pays the sewer charge?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It has turned the pipes to gold.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. Does the same meter now charge us for gold drainage?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our garden fountain grants wishes. Fine. We're still paying for its water.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wished for ten more. We can sell admission.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Eleven fountains on our meter. Charge enough to cover that.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Visitors wished for fountains at home. They're all fed from ours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we're paying to water the whole queue's gardens. Sell them monthly passes before the next bill arrives.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's free water causes A3's sewer question; B4's gold pipes cause A5's gold-drainage question, though pipe material need not change the charge.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 offer increasingly extravagant solutions while A maintains a credible concern about shared costs.

heightening.evidence: A5 worries that B4's valuable plumbing complicates the same ongoing bill rather than removing it.

specificity.evidence: A1's wishing fountain, A3's sewer charge and A5's meter make the fantastical premise materially playable.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's sewer-charge follow-up earns its mundanity by accepting B2's free-water solution.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's ten additional fountains and admission proposal produce A3's eleven-fountain pricing concern. B4's shared supply produces A5's recurring-pass proposal.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants admission income and A3 collaborates on pricing, but B4 mainly supplies another magical complication without much personal response to its cost.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a shared garden fountain and water bill; A3's meter and A5's monthly passes give the fantasy practical handles.

The newly illustrative garden attraction keeps one household meter and makes each magical expansion increase its water use. B wants admission income, giving the accounting practical purpose. Separate internal reread under coach-1.0: fidelity 5, A1, A3 and A5 return to the same bill; logic 5, B2 causes eleven-fountain pricing and B4 causes recurring passes for remote supply; relationship 4, B proposes a shared business and A develops its terms; heightening 4, A5 turns local operating cost into continuing liability for visitors' gardens; specificity 5, A1's garden and A3's meter make ownership clear; brevity 4, A5's subscription solution follows the ongoing expense. beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Nothing to do with who helped you move.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which photo should go on the reunion poster? Mine or Sam's?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sam's is sharper.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sharpness first. Would you at least show the committee mine first?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll send both together. Same size.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Equal treatment. After three weekends helping you move. Could mine at least be the attachment they open first? Just readability.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 disguises a loyalty choice as poster selection; A3 judges B2's technical answer, and A5 denies the test while invoking moving help.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 twists B2's 'sharper' into a personal judgment; B4's correction prompts A5's denial and disclosure of the emotional debt.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants the better poster photo and B4 defends that practical remit; A5 establishes a friendship with remembered favors.

heightening.evidence: After B4 challenges the insinuation, A5 raises the stakes from photographic preference to repayment of personal help.

specificity.evidence: A1 supplies a reunion poster and two competing photos; A5 adds the concrete history of helping B move.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'what clarity means to you' economically converts image quality into loyalty; A5's denial carries the accusation.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 judges 'Sharpness first'; A5 judges 'Equal treatment' against moving help, then disguises another loyalty test as readability.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's sharper photograph prompts A3's request for presentation priority; B4's simultaneous mailing prompts A5's attachment-order test.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants image quality and B4 offers fairness; A5 reveals a friendship debt that makes these neutral decisions personally consequential.

heightening.evidence: A5 invokes three weekends of moving help and narrows the test to opening order after B4 removes size and sending priority.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a reunion poster decision; A3 supplies the committee and A5 supplies the history of moving help.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'Sharpness first' efficiently judges B; A5's 'Just readability' earns its joke through the transparent concealment.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 chooses Sam for sharpness; A3 judges that criterion and substitutes showing A's photo first.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 offers equal size and simultaneous delivery; A5 judges the equality and seeks preferential opening order.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A1, A3 and A5 invent progressively smaller preferences as concealed loyalty tests; A3 and A5 explicitly evaluate B's responses.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 makes the friendship obligation explicit while preserving the practical cover for a new test.

mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A3 grades B2's photographic preference and requests preferential presentation; A5 grades B4's fairness and invents another preference disguised as readability.

recommendedEdit: Revised the rejected candidate because its final grievance supplied no fresh test. The reunion-poster setting remains; committee submission is new. Separate internal reread under coach-1.0: fidelity 5, as A3 and A5 judge responses and conceal successive tests; logic 5, as B2's sharpness produces the presentation request and B4's simultaneous submission produces attachment ordering; relationship 4, as B4 offers fair treatment against A5's friendship debt; heightening 4, as A5 seeks preferential ordering even within equal treatment; specificity 4, from A1's poster and B4's submission arrangement; brevity/wit 4, as A5's 'Just readability' supplies a concise practical cover. cards.title: Prove Your Loyalty
cards.instruction: Invent small tests of loyalty and judge every response without admitting there is a test.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you keep Friday free? No particular reason.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've promised to help Alex.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Even if something important came up here?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Has something come up?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not yet. I'm learning whether it would matter.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you keep Friday free? I might need help moving.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've promised to help Alex paint.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Right. Paint takes priority. Could you at least leave your phone on?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Of course. Have you actually found a flat?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Still looking. Nice that I'm worth a charged battery. This is just planning.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 and A3 invent an availability test, but A5's 'I'm learning whether it would matter' effectively admits the assessment.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's promise to Alex produces A3's competing hypothetical; B4 asks whether it is real, and A5 answers 'Not yet.'

relationship.evidence: B2 has an existing commitment to Alex and B4 reasonably checks whether A has an actual need.

heightening.evidence: A5 clarifies A's suspicion after B4 but does not add a fresh test or a more consequential choice.

specificity.evidence: A1 names Friday and B2 names Alex, but 'something important' in A3 leaves the shared situation indistinct.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's hypothetical pressure is concise; A5's diagnostic phrasing is sharp but explains the concealed game.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 requests a speculative commitment; A3 judges Alex's priority and invents a smaller test; A5 calls the judgment 'planning.'

responseLogic.evidence: B2's painting commitment produces A3's phone fallback; B4's agreement and flat question produce A5's battery judgment and admission.

relationship.evidence: B2 has an existing obligation and B4 offers help while checking whether A actually needs it.

heightening.evidence: A5 reveals there is no flat while assigning emotional value to B4's phone availability, exposing the disproportionate demand.

specificity.evidence: A1's Friday move and B2's promise to Alex make the competing commitments immediately playable.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'worth a charged battery' converts the practical concession into loyalty accounting, though the denial slightly explains it.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: Alex's prior claim on Friday makes A judge B's priorities and reduce the request to phone availability.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B agrees to keep the phone on and questions the move; A answers both by revealing the speculative need and grading the concession.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A repeatedly disguises tests of personal importance as moving arrangements.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: Even B's helpful agreement becomes evidence of insufficient loyalty.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: D11 makes A covertly test allegiance through requests for availability and judge both refusal and accommodation without acknowledging a test.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: A real request for moving help would accept scheduling information without converting it into a measure of personal worth.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Revised A3 judges painting as a rival priority; A5 judges B4's helpful offer while maintaining the cover of practical planning.

recommendedEdit: Revised because original A5 disclosed the test. The new moving-plan setting gives B a real commitment and makes B4's help the next test. Second internal pass: fidelity 5, logic 5, relationship 4, heightening 4, specificity 4, brevity 4; total 90. A3 uses painting, and A5 uses both phone availability and the flat question.
remainingConcern: No rewrite needed in this review. A5's explicit denial is slightly emphatic.
writerReservation: A's judgments remain conspicuous, as the card permits; the performance should treat 'just planning' as a sincere cover rather than a wink.
alternativeComparison: Unlike a's retrospective favor debt, b makes a helpful concession become the next loyalty judgment.

cards.title: Give It Up
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender something they value.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me have the medal for the charity auction.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's the only thing I've ever won.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it should raise more than the toaster.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could I lend it for the display?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The bidder will need more than a temporary victory.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me have the medal for the charity auction.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's the only thing I've ever won.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it should raise more than the toaster.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could I lend it for the display? I still want people to know I won.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then present it to the buyer yourself. I'll print your name in the programme; everyone will know whose medal was worth giving up.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 seeks permanent surrender for auction, B2 establishes the medal's value, and A5 rejects the temporary loan offered in B4.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 converts B2's unique victory into auction value; A5 answers B4's proposed display loan with the bidder's need for ownership.

relationship.evidence: B2 protects a cherished achievement and B4 offers a compromise, giving A something more substantial than simple refusal.

heightening.evidence: B4 offers temporary access, and A5 insists on permanent transfer by introducing the eventual bidder's claim.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a charity auction; B2's sole medal and A3's toaster make the conflicting valuations immediately playable.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's toaster comparison exposes A's fundraising priorities; A5's 'temporary victory' grows directly from the offered loan.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 requests the medal for sale; A5 rejects B4's loan compromise by proposing that B personally surrender it to the buyer.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 converts B2's unique achievement into auction value; A5 directly addresses B4's wish for recognition through presentation and programme credit.

relationship.evidence: B2 explains the medal's personal value, and B4 offers a display loan; A5 bargains with recognition rather than merely repeating the demand.

heightening.evidence: A5 moves beyond donating an object to having B publicly enact the surrender, using B4's desire for credit.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a charity auction immediately; B2's only medal, A3's toaster and A5's programme make the encounter readily playable.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's toaster comparison compresses A's instrumental thinking; A5 earns its reframing of personal achievement as a valuable sacrifice.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 identifies the medal as B's only win; A3 treats that significance as a reason it should outperform an ordinary auction lot.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 wants continued recognition and offers only a loan; A5 supplies public recognition conditional on permanent surrender.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A consistently pursues possession and sale of something B explicitly values, adapting the persuasion to B's stated attachment.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 turns B's proposed display into a public handover, increasing B's involvement without assuming consent.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: D12 makes A persuade B to relinquish something whose personal value B actively establishes and defends.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Merely borrowing a prop or wanting to win a dispute would not establish surrender of something B values.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: B2 establishes the medal's unique value; B4 separates public recognition from permanent surrender, and A5 offers recognition specifically in exchange for giving it away.

recommendedEdit: Revised the rejected final restatement into a persuasive offer. The charity auction and medal remain; a presentation and programme are new illustrative details. Separate internal reread under coach-1.0: fidelity 5, because A5 bargains for permanent surrender of B2's only medal; logic 5, because A3 monetizes B2's uniqueness and A5 answers B4's wish for recognition; relationship 4, because B4 proposes a loan and explains the attachment; heightening 4, because A5 commits to a ceremony and printed attribution; specificity 5, from A1's auction and B4's precise concern; brevity/wit 4, because A5 makes giving up the victory another source of distinction. Weighted total 92. Five spoken ABABA turns, under 75 words; B has not accepted. Original firstPass remains unchanged.
remainingConcern: A3's inference from personal significance to sale price is glib rather than persuasive, but it is coherent character logic. No rewrite needed.
writerReservation: A's offer depends on having some influence over the auction programme. A3 still assumes personal uniqueness will increase market value.
alternativeComparison: This version offers public recognition in exchange for surrender; the preserved guitar alternative uses household need and redirects a proposed partial concession.

cards.title: Give It Up
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender something they value.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Give me the last word in this argument.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. You're right.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Without that sigh.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I didn't say anything else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your sigh kept a spare last word. Hand that over too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Would you sell your signed guitar so we can replace the fridge?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I queued all night for that signature.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then let's price it properly. Those hours should buy us an ice maker.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll sell the case. The guitar stays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep the case. You can still tell the queue story while I photograph the guitar.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 demands the last word, but B2 immediately gives it up; neither B2 nor B4 establishes that this is something B values.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 introduces a sigh absent from B2's spoken text; A5 uses B4's distinction between speech and silence coherently once that sigh is assumed.

relationship.evidence: B2 tries to end the argument and B4 defends compliance, but A's pursuit is primarily control over B's delivery.

heightening.evidence: A5 expands A3's objection into ownership of the sigh, though the requested surrender remains figurative.

specificity.evidence: A1 identifies only 'this argument'; B2 and B4 supply no topic, setting, or valued stake.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'spare last word' economically develops A3's sigh, although the verbal invention carries more weight than the card.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 targets B's signed guitar; A3 converts its sentimental history into price and A5 keeps pursuing its surrender.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 prices B2's overnight queue; A5 reverses B4's case-only offer, preserving the souvenir while selling the valued instrument.

relationship.evidence: A1 establishes a shared fridge need; B2 and B4 defend personal attachment through a concrete counteroffer.

heightening.evidence: A5 moves from suggesting a sale to preparing its photograph while offering B the case as consolation.

specificity.evidence: A1's broken-fridge need, B2's signature queue and A3's ice maker define playable competing values.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'Keep the case' precisely reverses B4's bargain and reduces the treasured experience to a story.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B's overnight investment becomes A's justification for a higher selling price.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B offers the case while protecting the guitar; A reverses which object B may keep.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A repeatedly reframes B's attachment to secure surrender of the guitar.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A begins arranging the sale while adapting the compromise, leaving B free to resist.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: D12 makes A seek surrender of a treasured possession by converting B's reasons for keeping it into arguments for letting it go.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: General dominance demands obedience; this card needs a valued thing and sustained persuasion toward its surrender.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Revised B2 establishes the signature's personal cost, A3 converts that cost into sale value, and A5 bargains over B4's proposed partial surrender.

recommendedEdit: Replaced the unspecified argument with a signed-guitar sale for a shared fridge. Second internal pass: fidelity 5, logic 5, relationship 4, heightening 4, specificity 5, brevity 4; total 92. B2's queue informs A3's pricing; B4's case offer causes A5 to reverse which object B should keep.
remainingConcern: No rewrite needed. A5 assumes momentum rather than gaining consent, which should remain a playable tactic.
writerReservation: A5 presumes momentum toward a sale, but B has not agreed and remains free to resist; A's household justification should stay sincere.
alternativeComparison: The shared domestic necessity and inverted counteroffer distinguish b from a's charity solicitation.

cards.title: Helpful Culprit
cards.instruction: Hide that the problem is your fault while enthusiastically helping investigate it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've started investigating the broken vase. First, we check the window.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why have you got glue on your fingers?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent clue. I'll inspect the glue cupboard personally.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A piece of vase is stuck to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Put me in charge of preserving it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've started investigating the broken vase. First, we check the window.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why have you got glue on your fingers?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent clue. I'll inspect the glue cupboard personally.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A piece of vase is stuck to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Put me in charge of preserving it.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 volunteers an investigation; A3 and A5 turn evidence implicating A into opportunities to control the inquiry.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's glue produces A3's cupboard inspection, and B4's attached shard produces A5's evidence-preservation role.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 keep directing attention to A's body, resisting A1's attempt to investigate the window.

heightening.evidence: B4 escalates from suspicious glue to an actual vase fragment; A5 responds by seeking custody of that evidence.

specificity.evidence: A1 names a broken vase and window; B2 and B4 provide visible, playable evidence without separate narration.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'Excellent clue' and A5's 'preserving it' give self-protection the concise vocabulary of helpful investigation.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 volunteers an investigation, A3 redirects incriminating glue, and A5 seeks custody of the evidence attached to A.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's glue produces A3's cupboard inspection; B4's attached shard produces A5's preservation assignment.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 persistently direct scrutiny at A, forcing A to disguise evasion as useful investigative work.

heightening.evidence: A5 seeks control of direct physical evidence after A3's attempt to redirect attention elsewhere.

specificity.evidence: A1's broken vase, B2's glue and B4's stuck fragment give actors a clear physical investigation.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'Excellent clue' and A5's preservation request turn exposure into enthusiastic assistance without explanation.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: Glue on A's fingers prompts A to move the investigation to its storage location.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: The shard attached to A prompts a request to preserve that very evidence.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A conceals responsibility by volunteering for investigative jobs that redirect or control evidence.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: The evidence becomes harder to distance from A, so A incorporates it into the helpful role.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: D13 makes A conceal culpability by enthusiastically adopting investigative tasks that redirect or contain incriminating evidence.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Simple subject avoidance would leave the investigation; A instead remains conspicuously useful inside it.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A3 volunteers to inspect the glue source and A5 requests preservation duties precisely when B identifies evidence attached to A.

writerReservation: Glue and a shard imply involvement in handling or repair more directly than causing the break; culpability remains an inference.

cards.title: Helpful Culprit
cards.instruction: Hide that the problem is your fault while enthusiastically helping investigate it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The office plant's dead. I'll interview everyone who watered it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You watered it with coffee.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we must investigate the coffee machine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You made the coffee.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Conveniently, I know exactly where to begin.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The office plant's dead. I'll interview everyone who watered it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You watered it with coffee.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent lead. I'll test the machine. It may be dispensing something harmful.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A turns increasingly specific evidence against A into an increasingly elaborate experiment.

mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Revised A3 offers machine testing, and A5 uses B4's six sugars to propose comparison samples and blame the plant's tolerance.

cards.title: Merciful Lie
cards.instruction: Choose a truth your character believes would hurt someone. Keep it from them, even as honesty becomes harder.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The bakery loved your cake. They're just reorganising their menu.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The letter says 'inedible.'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They mean it deserves preservation, not eating.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It says the same about the icing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A very consistent compliment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The bakery can't sell your cake, love. They think it's too special to slice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The letter says 'inedible.' I thought I'd finally found something I was good at.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You have. Display cakes aren't meant to be eaten.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then I'll ask them to put it in the window.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me ask. I'll explain the display concept before they get confused again.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 conceals rejection and A3 reinterprets 'inedible' to protect B, but A5 offers little further effort to keep the hurtful truth hidden.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 directly redefines B2's quoted word; A5 calls B4's repeated criticism consistent, using the icing detail only lightly.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 supply rejection evidence, but neither establishes B's hope or the personal hurt A is trying to prevent.

heightening.evidence: B4 repeats the same adjective about icing; A5 summarizes the existing lie rather than constructing a more costly protection.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a cake submission to a bakery, and B2 supplies a rejection letter with a concrete assessment.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's preservation reinterpretation is economical; A5's 'consistent compliment' is tidy but functions chiefly as a closing quip.

cardFidelity.evidence: B2 explicitly connects rejection to wounded self-worth; A3 invents display cakes and A5 shields B from the bakery's response.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 reinterprets B2's 'inedible'; B4 adopts that explanation, causing A5 to intercept contact with the bakery.

relationship.evidence: A1's 'love' establishes affection; B2 reveals vulnerability and B4 actively pursues the opportunity A invented.

heightening.evidence: A5 commits to managing an outside conversation because B4 turns the comforting lie into a practical plan.

specificity.evidence: A1's bakery rejection and B2's letter make the painful truth and protective lie immediately clear.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's display-cake explanation creates the next problem; A5's 'confused again' sustains the protective fiction economically.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B presents the rejection and its emotional significance; A supplies a category in which inedibility could be intentional.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B plans to request a window display; A volunteers to speak first to prevent the bakery exposing the lie.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: Concern for B's confidence explains each increasingly demanding attempt to conceal the rejection.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: B's hopeful acceptance forces A to extend the lie beyond their private conversation.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: D15 makes A conceal a truth believed to wound B and deepen the protective lie when B's response makes concealment harder.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Ordinary optimism would find a benefit in rejection; A instead misrepresents what the bakery meant to preserve B's self-belief.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Revised B2 explicitly links the verdict to personal competence, while A3 invents a display category and A5 intercepts verification.

recommendedEdit: Kept the bakery setting, made the feared hurt explicit, and gave B a constructive plan that endangers the lie. Second internal pass: fidelity 5, logic 5, relationship 4, heightening 4, specificity 4, brevity 4; total 90. B4's proposed direct contact forces A5 to volunteer as intermediary.
remainingConcern: No rewrite needed. The bakery intervention remains a proposal, keeping the actual scene open.
writerReservation: A5 risks sounding controlling unless played as urgent care for B; the bakery's response remains unresolved.
alternativeComparison: Alternative a makes B's hopeful cooperation increase the protective burden; b uses successive factual rebuttals.

cards.title: Merciful Lie

cards.title: Confess First
cards.instruction: Get someone else to confess or incriminate themselves before you reveal anything.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Did you cause the jam? I need that cleared up first.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
